sharedOwnership.identity: Host owns metadata.name and namespaced metadata.namespace; identities lock on edit.
sharedOwnership.source: Host owns canonical AST, source preference, discovery, schema, authorization, atomic patches and local submission.
sharedOwnership.registration: Parent aggregates index.ts resourceEditors. Group adds no second registry.
sharedOwnership.policy: DeviceClass, ResourceClaimTemplate and DeviceTaintRule declare declarative policy; ResourceClaim declares conditional policy; ResourceSlice declares controller policy. Policies never grant permission and managed ownership overrides authoring.
sharedOwnership.safety: No driver parameters, annotation values or status.devices[].data are read or serialized by forms. Annotation values and opaque parameters are sensitive paths. Source raw access remains host-owned.
sharedOwnership.availability: Every exact target still requires installed discovery/schema and actual authorized verbs. Schema presence never proves driver support or enabled feature gates.
